title: The restricted derived section square for arbitrary source sheaves
statement: Let $S,Y,Y\prime$ be schemes, $a:Y\prime\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $h\prime:Y\prime\to S$, and $h\circ a=h\prime$. Let $U\to S$ be etale and $p\in\mathbb N$. Let $G,F$ be abelian etale sheaves on $Y$ and $G\prime,F\prime$ such sheaves on $Y\prime$, with $e:a^*G\cong G\prime$, $\phi:a^*F\to F\prime$, and $t:G[0]\to F[0][p]$ in the bounded-below derived category. Write $T_h=H^0R\Gamma(U\times_S Y,r^*(-))$, using the restriction and single comparisons of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. Let $z_h:T_h(G[0])\cong\Gamma(U\times_S Y,r^*G)$ be its zero comparison and $s_{h,F}:T_h(F[0][p])\cong H^p(U\times_S Y,r^*F)$ its shift comparison. Define $b_G=z_h\,q^*\,\Gamma(\psi_{e})\,z_{h\prime}^{-1}$ in composition order, where $q=U\times_S a$, $q^*$ is ordinary section pullback by the adjunction unit and $\psi_e:q^*r^*G\to r\prime^*G\prime$ is the restricted coefficient map for $e.\mathrm{hom}$ of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. Let $t\prime$ be $t$ pulled back by $a$, precomposed with $e^{-1}$ and the inverse single comparison, and postcomposed with the shift comparison and $\phi[p]$. If $R_{a,\phi}$ is the restricted-cohomology map of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], then $T_h(t)\,s_{h,F}\,R_{a,\phi}=b_G\,T_{h\prime}(t\prime)\,s_{h\prime,F\prime}$ as homomorphisms. No represented generator is chosen.

proof.text: Use the explicit natural transformation restrictedSectionPullback and its degree-zero comparison to identify its component on G[0], after postcomposition by the single comparison and e.hom, with transportZero.
Use its shifted-single comparison on F[0][p] to identify its component followed by the pullback shift/single comparison and phi with shiftIso followed by rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap.

Apply naturality of this constructed natural transformation to t. Rewrite its two components by the preceding comparisons. The composite alpha of the single comparison and single(e.hom) has inverse single(e.inv) followed by the inverse single comparison. Functoriality sends alpha followed by its inverse to the identity. Cancel this pair, expand pullbackHom, and reassociate; this proves the required equality.

theorem restrictedDerivedEvaluation_pullback {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h') (p : ℕ)
    (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (e : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).obj G ≅ G')
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (F' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).obj F ⟶ F') (U : S.Etale)
    (t : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(p : ℤ)⟧) :
    (Hzero h U).map t ≫ (shiftIso h p F U).hom ≫
        rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap a h h' w p F F' φ U =
      transportZero a h h' w G G' e.hom U ≫
        (Hzero h' U).map (pullbackHom a p e φ t) ≫ (shiftIso h' p F' U).hom
